thresholds.title: Abuse detection
thresholds.intro: Set the thresholds that raise an alert to the administrators of the entity (mail and webhooks). Untick a rule to disable it. Daily counters are computed per day of the chosen time zone, from the transfers of the entity.

groups.senderHint: An overrun raises an alert, once per sender, rule and day.
groups.unusualHint: These rules only alert: they never block a transfer.
groups.externalHint: External quotas apply to invited addresses and to recipients replying to a transfer.

maxDailyBytesPerSender.label: Maximum volume per sender per day
maxDailyBytesPerSender.hint: Total size of the files sent by one sender in the day.

maxDailyTransfersPerSender.label: Maximum transfers per sender per day

blockOnExceed.label: Block instead of only alerting
blockOnExceed.hint: When ticked, a transfer that would exceed a per-sender limit or an external quota is refused (the sender sees an explicit message). Otherwise only an alert is sent. The “unusual behaviour” rules never block a transfer.

unusualVolumeFactor.label: Unusual volume factor
unusualVolumeFactor.hint: Alert when the daily volume exceeds this multiple of the average daily volume over the last 30 days. Between {min} and {max}, one decimal.

unusualMinHistoryDays.label: Minimum days of history
unusualMinHistoryDays.hint: Days of activity needed before the rule applies to a sender ({min} to {max}).

largeExternalTransferBytes.label: Large transfer to an external address
largeExternalTransferBytes.hint: Alert for a transfer at least this large with a recipient outside the internal domains.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: IANA name, for example Europe/Paris. It sets the start of the day of the counters and the office hours.

officeHours.label: Office hours
officeHours.hint: A transfer created outside these hours raises an alert.
officeHours.endHint: After the start; 24:00 for the end of the day.

maxInvitationsPerInviter.label: Invitations per internal user per hour

externalMaxDailyBytes.label: Maximum external volume per address per day
externalMaxDailyBytes.hint: Volume an external address may deposit in the day.

externalMaxDailyDeposits.label: Maximum external deposits per address per day
externalMaxDailyDeposits.hint: Transfers an external address may create in the day.

errors.required: Enter a value or untick the rule.
errors.integerMin: Enter a whole number of at least {min}.
errors.integerRange: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
errors.factor: Enter a number between {min} and {max}, with at most one decimal.
errors.timeZone: This time zone is unknown. Use an IANA name, for example Europe/Paris or UTC.

office.start: The start time must be HH:MM, for example 08:00.
office.end: The end time must be HH:MM (or 24:00), for example 19:00.
office.order: The end time must be after the start time.
office.weekdays: Choose at least one working day.
